This page manages Intent candidates for sharing, multi-file sharing, opening, browsers, and text processing. You can hide or keep components by rule, or change a component's display name in the system chooser. It does not modify the actual Intent, package name, component name, disable apps, or uninstall apps.
Current mode: Hide selected. Once the rules are active, selected components are hidden from the corresponding candidate lists; deselect them to restore the default display.
Current mode: Show selected only. Once the rules are active, selected components remain in the corresponding category and other components are hidden.
Current mode: Show all. System candidate-list cleaning is paused. Selections are saved but take effect after cleaning is resumed.

Select an app to batch-select components shown under the current category and search conditions. Expand an app to select individual components, or tap the pencil to change a component's menu name for the current category. Names and selection rules are independent; save an empty name to restore the original. View only filters this page and does not change cleaning rules.

Editing dedicated rules for “Open · %1$s”. Effective selections combine the generic OPEN rules from All with rules dedicated to the current type. Inherited items remain selected and show their source when expanded. Inherited items must be deselected under All; rules added for the current type affect only that MIME, scheme, or file-extension type.

Saving locally does not mean the system has applied the configuration. Use the configuration acknowledgement as the source of truth; Resolver-side behavior still needs real-device verification.

Query and app-visibility counts come from actual system_server execution. Ordering usually runs in a separate Resolver/Chooser process, so an ordering count of 0 alone does not prove ordering is broken. Diagnostic mode records Resolver-side ORDER_DELIVERED; verify the final menu on the device.

Compatibility fallback for file managers whose own chooser lists bypass normal Resolver rules, such as ES File Explorer. For selected source apps, target packages from generic and typed OPEN rules can be hidden from package visibility. Share and text-processing rules do not contribute package hiding.
Selections are saved immediately and only apply in Hide selected mode. This runs in android/system_server and hides the whole target package from the source app; it cannot hide only one Activity.

Scanning discovers manageable candidates and may not exactly match every live menu. Non-text categories keep empty-list protection; text processing may hide all candidates and cannot change hard-coded in-app menus.
Preview final open targets with an actual file

When enabled, records query categories, rules, and skip reasons, including the first valid query stack by category and calling UID. Management scans do not consume stack records. Runtime logs only file extensions and detected types, not full filenames or URIs. Key records are limited to 200 per process every 5 seconds, with candidate details limited to 40.
Diagnostics enabled; reproduce the share, open, or text-processing operation.

Enable diagnostics first, reproduce the problem, then export. The package includes up to 12 LSPosed logs from the last 24 hours; large files retain the beginning and newest tail. Raw system logs can contain data from other processes, so review before sharing. Root access is required; read failures are recorded in the package.
